description: Approve the proposed backlog for an initiative (HIL #1). Promotes its BACKLOG items to READY and moves the initiative to IN_PROGRESS. Pass `deferItemIds` to leave chosen proposed items out of the approval: they stay in the backlog marked deferred, are never promoted or auto-dispatched, and come back through anyforge_update_work_item action='undefer'. Refused with a 400 and nothing written when an id is not one of this plan's proposed items (defer_item_not_proposed), is the integration-validation item (defer_item_not_deferrable), would defer every item (defer_all_items), or is a dependency of an item being approved (defer_breaks_dependency). Requires `approve` scope.

deferItemIds.description: Work item ids (from anyforge_list_work_items) of proposed items to defer instead of approving.

deferReason.description: Optional reason recorded on each deferred item and in the audit trail.

name: anyforge_approve_backlog
title: Approve backlog
